messages.subject: Quartz House - contract mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Martin,

Our mark-up of the contract attached (redline against your v1). The main changes: completion date moved to 15 May; draft transfer to be delivered at least ten working days before completion; and we've reinstated a seller obligation to insure to full reinstatement value until completion. The TOGC and rent-deposit assignment provisions are agreed.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
